revisions_note: log-spaced Pythia public revisions step0..step143000; M=12 (410m: M=8) is far coarser than the paper's M=201 — the nomogram takes M as an input, see _meta in results
detector_convention: tau = chance + 0.10 (paper's BIG-Bench audit DELTA_PRINCIPAL); sustained-K with K from the paper's nomogram K = ceil((ln M - ln alpha)/ln(1/qhat)), alpha=0.05
generative_scope_note: gen + lastword tasks have chance ~ 0 and are OUT of the binomial-null calibration (audit convention, Schaeffer-style metric discontinuity); they serve as genuine-emergence preservation probes. wiki_bpb is a continuous control.
